notes.title: Update Multiplayer
notes.content:
Khan VS Kahn can be played cross platform with Mac and Windows.
When you received an invite from a friend you can now use the Steam contextual menu to join him.
All the network messages are now directly managed by Steam.

We are available to play with you, join our discord : https://discordapp.com/invite/YvEmFc5

notes.title: Khan VS Kahn Steam Version 1.4
notes.content:
We are proud to announce the new 1.4 version of our game Khan VS Kahn.


Build the best town with your friends in Khan vs Kahn. Release on Steam this August 27th, 2019 for 0.99$.
Try to find the perfect place to set up your camp in this heroic-fantasy game. Get one of your best friend to play with and against you in the same area. Use the enemy’s building to make him loose money, food, or wood and gather resources to win the game. But be careful your enemy can do the same with your building.

So ? Do you want to settle down?
 

Khan VS Kahn is a turn-based strategy game.
Challenge a friend or play against an AI  in a 1v1 duel where only the smartest wins every time.
A mix between European board games and sid meier’s civilization
Two races compete to be the best and achieve one of the 5 victory types
You can use your enemy’s building, but be careful, he can use yours!Which kind of victory are you going to achieve?

Key Features :
[list]
[*] Play against a friend or an AI
[*] races with special abilities (human, elf, orc, troll)
[*] differents building to help you win the game
[*] 5 differents victory types
[*] Local multiplayer
[*] Online multiplayer
[*] A skill tree that can change the game
[*] A wonder with 5 layers of construction
[*] Up to 3 level of AI
[/list]

Here is the changelog of the new 1.4 Version of Khan VS Kahn

– Added new UI Design
– Added a new Story Mode with Skeleton
– Added Multiplayer Online with Steam Friends
– Added Steam achievements
